title: Why Alien Life Would be our Doom - The Great Filter
summary: A short Kurzgesagt animation explaining the Great Filter, the idea that finding alien life might be bad news because it implies something usually destroys civilizations. It connects the concept to the Fermi paradox.
why: HN links it as a concise, accessible explainer whenever the Fermi paradox or Great Filter comes up, though one commenter criticized its lack of source attribution.

quote.text: There is also a good video from Kurzgesagt explaining the great filter
